# "Kan det här vara en börssignal?"

**Feed**: efn-borsfrukost  
**Published**: 2026-09-21  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

EFN Morgon expected a positive Stockholm open, helped by lower oil prices and optimism around US-China talks, even though Wall Street had its worst week since March. The main stories were Volvo Cars' surprise appointment of Skoda chief Klaus Zellmer as CEO, Volkswagen's Friday profit warning, Novo Nordisk's capital markets day as it loses share to Eli Lilly, and a run of mostly small Stockholm IPOs starting with Axevik. The hosts were doubtful about how good these IPOs are. They ended with a light-hearted remark that Yom Kippur has often marked the end of the weak September stretch and could be a moment to buy stocks.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 MTRS — Munters | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 60%

Nordea (cited analyst) keeps buy despite cutting the target to 215 from 250. Stock around SEK 130, well below the target.

#### Reasoning

This is a cited analyst view, not the hosts' own. Nordea kept its buy rating while lowering the target price. The stock has fallen sharply to about SEK 130, leaving large upside to 215. The host only said it is worth keeping an eye on.

#### Sell Triggers

- further target cuts or a downgrade from Nordea
- continued weak order intake

> *"Munters Nordea sänker kursen till 215 från 250. Däremot så upprepar man köp."*

---

### 🟠 VOLCAR-B — Volvo Cars | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 40%

New CEO Zellmer: strong record at Skoda but weak in China. Failure to find an internal candidate adds uncertainty.

#### Reasoning

The hosts were split. A fresh outside view could help, but Zellmer has not succeeded in China, the key market. The previous outside CEO, Jim Rowan, failed to turn the company around. The stock also fell on VW's profit warning. No clear direction.

#### Sell Triggers

- no progress in China
- unclear governance around Samuelsson's future role

> *"Det skulle kunna vara positivt med ett nytt namn, ny fläkt."*

---

### 🟠 NOVO-B — Novo Nordisk | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 50%

Capital markets day. Market wants answers on the oral drug launch and ex-US rollout. Losing share to Lilly; shares down 68% over two years.

#### Reasoning

The capital markets day is a near-term catalyst. The oral drug market and launch pace outside the US are the key questions. Lilly leads in the US at 61% vs Novo's 39% per Citi, and Lilly may have a next-generation drug coming. The host said the company really needs to act to regain investor interest.

#### Sell Triggers

- weak oral-drug guidance at the capital markets day
- further share loss to Lilly

> *"Så man behöver verkligen göra någonting för att öka på sin börsvikt igen."*

---

### ⛔ VOW3 — Volkswagen | **AVOID** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Negative | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 40%

Dramatic profit warning: Porsche goodwill writedown, weak China and restructuring costs. Removed from the Euro Stoxx 50.

#### Reasoning

The profit warning and index exit point to near-term pressure. The hosts gave no explicit recommendation, so this is only a weak negative inference.

> *"Det kom ju en prognossänkning eller vinstvarning i fredags."*

---
